intro_en: You will learn how to talk about the ovoo and explain a ritual step by step, using Mongolian sequential converbs (-аад/-ээд) and the polite imperative. In English you will use "be supposed to" for the rules of a ritual.
intro_mn: Та овоотой холбоотой үг хэллэг, зан үйлийг дарааллаар нь тайлбарлахдаа -аад/-ээд нөхцөл болон эелдэг сануулах хэлбэрийг хэрэглэж сурна. Англи хэлэнд зан үйлийн дүрмийг хэлэхдээ "be supposed to" хэлбэрийг хэрэглэнэ.

vocab.example_mn: Давааны орой дээр том овоо байдаг.
vocab.example_en: There is a big ovoo at the top of the pass.
He tied a blue scarf to the ovoo.
Please add three stones to the ovoo.
People walk around the ovoo clockwise.

vocab.example_mn: Цагийн зүүний дагуу гурван удаа явна.

vocab.example_en: Put your offering at the ovoo.

vocab.en: mountain and water spirits; the land
vocab.example_en: Locals treat the spirits of their land with respect.

vocab.example_mn: Овоо тахих нь байгалийн мөргөлийн нэг хэлбэр.
vocab.example_en: Worshipping the ovoo is a form of nature worship.
Every year they honor their ovoo with a ceremony.

sentences.en: We stopped at the ovoo on the pass.
alt_en: We stopped at the ovoo at the mountain pass.

sentences.en: Please get out of the car and walk around the ovoo.
alt_en: Get out of the car and circle the ovoo, please.

sentences.mn: Эхлээд хадгаа бариад овооны өмнө зогсоорой.
sentences.en: First, hold your scarf and stand in front of the ovoo.
alt_en: First, take your scarf and stand in front of the ovoo.
sentences.mn_latin: Ekhleed khadgaa bariad ovoony ömnö zogsooroi.

sentences.mn: Цагийн зүүний дагуу гурван удаа тойрох ёстой.
sentences.en: You are supposed to walk around it three times clockwise.
alt_mn: Цагийн зүүний дагуу гурван удаа тойрох хэрэгтэй.
alt_en: You're supposed to circle it clockwise three times.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsagiin züünii daguu gurvan udaa toirokh yostoi.

sentences.en: Please pick up your stone and place it on the ovoo.
alt_en: Please pick up your stone and put it on the ovoo.

sentences.en: You are not supposed to throw stones at the ovoo.
alt_en: You shouldn't throw stones at the ovoo.

sentences.mn: Цэнхэр хадгаа уяад дараа нь чимээгүй мөргөөрэй.
sentences.en: Tie on your blue scarf, then bow quietly.
alt_mn: Цэнхэр хадгаа уяад дараа нь дуугүй мөргөөрэй.
alt_en: Tie your blue scarf, and after that pray quietly.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsenkher khadgaa uyaad daraa ni chimeegüi mörgöörei.

sentences.en: Place your offering and then walk around three times.
alt_en: Put down your offering, then go around three times.

sentences.mn: Уул усныхаа эздэд талархал илэрхийлэх ёстой.
sentences.en: You are supposed to show gratitude to the spirits of the mountains and waters.
alt_en: You're supposed to give thanks to the mountain spirits.
sentences.mn_latin: Uul usnykhaa ezded talarkhal ilerkhiilekh yostoi.

sentences.en: Let's walk around the ovoo and then get back on the road.
alt_en: After circling the ovoo, let's continue on our way.

sentences.mn: Миний өвөө байгалийн мөргөлийг гүн хүндэлдэг байсан.
sentences.en: My grandfather deeply respected nature worship.
alt_mn: Өвөө маань байгалийн мөргөлийг маш их хүндэлдэг байсан.
alt_en: My grandfather had deep respect for nature worship.
sentences.mn_latin: Minii övöö baigaliin mörgöliig gün khündeldeg baisan.

sentences.mn: Овоон дээр нулимж болохгүй гэж хөтөч сануулав.
sentences.en: The guide warned us that we were not supposed to spit on the ovoo.
alt_mn: Хөтөч овоон дээр нулимж болохгүй гэж сануулав.
alt_en: The guide reminded us not to spit on the ovoo.
sentences.mn_latin: Ovoon deer nulimj bolokhgüi gej khötöch sanuulav.

grammar.title_en: Step by step: -аад/-ээд and the polite imperative
grammar.title_mn: Дараалуулан тайлбарлах нь: -аад/-ээд ба эелдэг сануулах хэлбэр
grammar.explain_en: To list steps in order, Mongolian joins verbs with the sequential converb -аад/-ээд/-оод/-өөд (чулуугаа аваад тавиарай = "pick up your stone and then place it"). Only the last verb is in the imperative. For polite instructions, use -аарай/-ээрэй/-оорой/-өөрэй (тойроорой, зогсоорой, мөргөөрэй), which sounds like "please do...". Choose the vowel by harmony. Stems ending in the soft sign ь change it to и before the suffix: тавь- → тавиарай. In English, "be supposed to" states what the custom expects: "You're supposed to walk clockwise." The negative, "not supposed to", means it is forbidden by custom.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд ёс заншил, дүрмийг хэлэхдээ "be supposed to + үйл үгийн анхны хэлбэр" бүтцийг хэрэглэнэ: "You are supposed to walk clockwise" (Цагийн зүүний дагуу явах ёстой). Үгүйсгэвэл "are not supposed to" буюу "болохгүй" гэсэн утгатай. Өнгөрсөн үед "was/were supposed to" гэж хэлбэл "байх ёстой байсан (гэвч тэгээгүй)" гэсэн санаа илэрнэ. Дарааллыг "first, then, after that" гэх үгээр тодруулна, жишээ нь "First tie the scarf, then walk around."

Pick up your stone and place it on the ovoo.
Walk around three times and then bow.

fill_blank.translation: Tie your blue scarf and bow quietly.
fill_blank.explain_en: Хадаг drops its vowel before the reflexive possessive -аа in the accusative: хадгаа ("your own scarf").
fill_blank.explain_mn: Хадаг гэсэн үг тусагдахуун болж, өөрийнх гэсэн утгатай тул хадгаа гэж хэлнэ.

fill_blank.text: You are ___ to walk around the ovoo clockwise.
fill_blank.translation: Овоог цагийн зүүний дагуу тойрох ёстой.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Хөтөч өө, бид энэ овоон дээр юу хийх ёстой вэ?
dialogue.en: Guide, what are we supposed to do at this ovoo?
dialogue.mn_latin: Khötöch öö, bid ene ovoon deer yuu khiikh yostoi ve?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: First, get out of the car and pick up a stone.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Дараа нь яах вэ? Би хадаг уях уу?
dialogue.en: What do we do after that? Should I tie on a scarf?
dialogue.mn_latin: Daraa ni yaakh ve? Bi khadag uyakh uu?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, цэнхэр хадгаа уяад, чулуугаа овоон дээр тавиарай.
dialogue.en: Yes, tie your blue scarf and place the stone on the ovoo.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, tsenkher khadgaa uyaad, chuluugaa ovoon deer taviarai.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Тойрох үедээ аль зүгт явах вэ?
dialogue.en: Which direction do we walk when circling?
dialogue.mn_latin: Toirokh üyedee ali zügt yavakh ve?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.mn: Цагийн зүүний дагуу гурван удаа тойроорой. Тэр хооронд дуугүй байгаарай.
dialogue.en: Walk clockwise three times. Please stay quiet in the meantime.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tsagiin züünii daguu gurvan udaa toirooroi. Ter khoorond duugüi baigaarai.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Ойлголоо. Би өргөл тавьж болох уу?
dialogue.en: I see. May I leave an offering?
dialogue.mn_latin: Oilgoloo. Bi örgöl tavij bolokh uu?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.mn: Болно. Тойрч дууссаныхаа дараа уул усандаа талархаж мөргөөрэй.
dialogue.en: You may. After you finish circling, bow and give thanks to the mountain spirits.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bolno. Toirch duussanykhaa daraa uul usandaa talarkhaj mörgöörei.

culture_note.en: An ovoo is a sacred cairn of stones, wood or other offerings, usually built on a mountain pass or hilltop, where Mongolians honor the spirits of the land. Travelers walk around it clockwise three times, add a stone, and often tie a blue khadag, which stands for the sky. The tradition predates Buddhism, and many ovoo ceremonies today blend shamanic and Buddhist elements.
culture_note.mn: Овоо бол ихэвчлэн даваа, уулын оройд чулуу, мод болон бусад өргөлөөр босгосон ариун газар бөгөөд энд монголчууд нутгийн уул усны эздэд хүндэтгэл үзүүлдэг. Зорчигчид цагийн зүүний дагуу гурван удаа тойрч, чулуу нэмж, ихэнхдээ тэнгэрийг бэлгэддэг цэнхэр хадаг уядаг. Энэ уламжлал буддын шашнаас өмнө үүссэн бөгөөд өнөөдөр олон овооны тахилгад бөө мөргөл ба буддын шашны зан үйл хослон оршдог.

review.notes: Mostly good, but several awkward Mongolian sentences and a few inaccurate or unnatural items need fixing.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed a spatial mistranslation, an unnatural spirit term, the тавиарай explanation, an ambiguous blank, and several unnatural dialogue lines.

changes.why: 'уул усныхаа өмнө ханддаг' is unnatural; the standard phrasing is 'уул усандаа ханддаг'
The alternative was identical to the main sentence
'овоон дээр' means 'on', not 'near'; reported speech needs backshift to 'were'
The explanation of тавиарай was inaccurate
'тойрдог' and 'тойрсон' also form valid sentences, so the answer was not unique
'Манай хөтөч' is an unnatural way to address someone
'тойроод дууссаныхаа' is ungrammatical; it should be 'тойрч дууссаныхаа'
The subject was missing, and 'often' and 'many' were dropped compared with the English
